correctness.rationale: Define categorical-product edges by adjacent cycle layers and unequal colors. Augmented Hopf trace for a reflection on a complex with rational reduced homology only in odd degree 2r−1 yields trace = sum over invariant independent faces (−1)^(number of vertex-orbits). Such a face is an independent set of allowable reflection vertex-orbits; a reflected edge imposes an end cap forbidding multiple colors. Free/capped folded path layer states empty/singleton/multiple give M=[[1,1,1],[-n,-1,0],[n−1,0,0]], N=[[1,1,1],[-n,-1,0],[0,0,0]]. Independent symbolic multiplication confirms M³=(n−1)I, uᵀNMe=0, uᵀMe=0, uᵀNMNe=n(n−1). Free/capped lengths yield 0 (r odd), 0 (r even vertex axis), n(n−1)^(r/2) (r even edge axis) for all r≥1,n≥2. The homology concentration is the same-family published Theorem22 premise, which was verified in its displayed primary theorem excerpt.
residual_risks: If an alternative definition of C3 included self-loops the argument would fail; here C3 is the ordinary simple triangle as explicitly defined. No color permutations included.
